title: About: Kolami language
text: Kolami (Northwestern Kolami) is a tribal Central Dravidian language spoken in Maharashtra and Telangana states of India. It falls under the Kolami–Naiki group of languages. It is the most widely spoken Central Dravidian language.

title: Dravidian Group of Languages - Art and Culture Notes
text: November 9, 2024 - The earliest records of Dravidian languages can be found in ancient inscriptions and texts, such as the Tamil Sangam literature, which dates back over 2,000 years. These languages have significantly influenced the culture, religion, and art of southern India. For example, Tamil has a long literary tradition, and it is the language of classical literature, music, and dance in the Dravidian culture.
